caption: The drawing depicts a detailed figurehead of a woman rendered in shades of beige, cream, and brown with precise shading to indicate dimensionality and texture. The figure is shown in a three-quarter profile facing left, with her right arm extended forward and holding what appears to be a sheaf or cluster of wheat. She is dressed in an ornate gown featuring layered fabric, ruffles, and floral decorations, including leaf motifs near the neckline and on the skirt. The figure’s hair is styled back in waves and partially covered by a cap or headdress. Behind the upper portion of the body is a dark, elongated wooden support, depicted in brown tones, which contrasts with the lighter figure. The background is plain and unadorned, rendered in a uniform pale beige color. At the bottom left of the image, there is a faint handwritten inscription.
title: Belle of Oregon Figurehead
